{{Top|leg}}
'''Adder Ain-la''' was a [[Poet/Legends|poet]] famous for [[Gender/Legends|his]] denunciation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]: "A dead metal shell of a world, Coruscant is soulless beyond salvation, so cold and empty its frozen carcass must be heated with [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|solar mirrors]]."<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
